text: {"verdict": "denied", "governing_rule": "MP-IMG-001", "reason": "The clinical documentation does not demonstrate a trial of conservative management (e.g., physical therapy, NSAIDs, activity modification, or a home exercise program) of at least six weeks duration prior to this request, as required by policy MP-IMG-001 criterion 1. While objective exam findings (positive straight leg raise, reduced L5 sensation) and prior plain radiographs are documented, and no red-flag condition is present to waive this requirement, the absence of a documented conservative therapy trial and outcome does not meet the medical necessity criteria for lumbar MRI without contrast.", "missing_information": []}
